name: ShipWave Channels
author: switchlabsdev

sections.description:
Connect your WooCommerce source catalog and stock to ShipWave Channels. This
companion adds recoverable marketplace-order receipts and quantity-scoped
shipment tracking. It supports WooCommerce legacy orders and HPOS.

External service

This plugin is the companion for ShipWave Channels, operated by Levy Electric,
Inc. A ShipWave account and a connection from ShipWave to this WooCommerce store
are required. The plugin does not provide standalone marketplace connections.
ShipWave provides the hosted marketplace connections, synchronization and
fulfillment workflow. Service subscriptions and shipping charges are separate
from this free plugin; see the current service and pricing page below.
This package is prepared for WordPress.org distribution. A WooCommerce
Marketplace listing is separate from installation and is not required.

After the store owner authorizes access, ShipWave reads catalog, stock and order
data through WooCommerce’s API. Registered WooCommerce webhooks send product and
order events to ShipWave. Enabled write lanes let ShipWave create marketplace
order mirrors and save quantity-scoped tracking. Mirrors include the buyer’s
shipping details where the marketplace permits it. Amazon buyer name, street
address, phone and email are never written to WooCommerce; those mirrors use
“Marketplace Customer” placeholders with only city, state, postal code and country.
The companion authenticates these requests using the store’s WooCommerce API
key and its existing permissions. It does not execute payment gateways or refunds.

Service and pricing: https://shipwave.app/pricing
Setup and support: https://shipwave.app/help/connect-woocommerce-channels
Terms of service: https://shipwave.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://shipwave.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce. Enable WooCommerce stock management.
  2. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin. Upload the ShipWave
    Channels ZIP and activate it. After WordPress.org publication, you can also
    search for ShipWave Channels under Plugins > Add New and choose Install Now.
  3. In ShipWave, choose Stores > Connect > WooCommerce, enter your public HTTPS
    store address, and approve the read/write connection in WooCommerce.
  4. Start read-only sync, resolve SKU/stock mapping issues, and complete test-store
    acceptance before enabling order mirrors, marketplace stock, or tracking.
  5. Stop any previous connector writers before enabling ShipWave write lanes.

Alternatively, create a WooCommerce read/write REST API key for an administrator
and use ShipWave’s existing-API-keys option. Keep the key and secret private.
Public HTTPS with valid TLS is required. Private networks and redirecting REST
endpoints are unsupported.

Orders and tracking

Marketplace orders represent sales already paid on the marketplace. The plugin
does not charge a buyer, execute a payment gateway, or issue refunds. Source
stock is reserved and deducted through WooCommerce’s native stock functions.
Untracked, backordered, virtual or ambiguous shared-stock products are held.
Replaying an identical reference recovers its receipt. A changed or uncertain
request requires reconciliation instead of automatically creating another order.

In a WooCommerce order’s ShipWave shipment tracking box, enter a carrier, tracking
number and the exact quantities in one parcel, then use the order Update button.
Each parcel remains recorded. Partial parcels do not complete the entire order.
ShipWave shipping labels continue to use ShipWave’s warehouse and rate policies.

Recovery

If an order or shipment reports reconciliation required, pause the affected write
lane in ShipWave and inspect its source receipt and ShipWave Sync health. Do not
delete plugin claim/lock options, remove receipt metadata or re-create a reference
to bypass an uncertain result. Contact support@shipwave.app or consult the setup
guide above. Disabling the plugin stops companion writes; historical
orders, shipments, stock deductions and claims remain stored.
sections.faq:
Is a WooCommerce.com account required to connect my store?

No. Direct installation and store authorization use your own WordPress site.
A WooCommerce.com vendor account is a separate requirement for publishing this
plugin in Woo’s official Marketplace.

Can I keep another connector writing orders or inventory?

Complete a read-only comparison first, then disable the previous connector’s
affected writers before enabling the corresponding ShipWave write lanes.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Uses the distinct shipwave_channels prefix for declarations, form fields and new claims.
  • Preserves existing order and parcel receipts and honors legacy uncertain claims and locks.

1.0.2

  • Prepares WordPress.org readme metadata and service disclosures.
  • Directory packages use WordPress.org updates; direct-download packages retain
    the ShipWave Update URI and manual replacement workflow.

1.0.1

  • Amazon order mirrors use non-restricted buyer placeholders instead of being
    refused.
  • Declares cart/checkout block compatibility, sanitizes request input, caches the
    storage-engine check, and makes the tracking box translatable.
  • Adds tested-version metadata and an Update URI so unrelated directory plugins
    cannot replace this companion.

1.0.0

  • Initial companion with durable order receipts, native atomic stock reservation,
    exact parcel quantities, permission checks, and legacy/HPOS order support.
  • Direct download includes service disclosures, plugin metadata and GPL license.
